inputs.text: [tense] There's someone in the glass, over my shoulder. Don't turn us around. I want to see what it does if we change direction.
[nervous] I can see the mask. Are you sure it isn't another couple behind us? The reflection's full of people.
[tense] There. Nobody else did that. It waited for me, then took the same step. Whatever it is, it's watching us.
[nervous] Or following us. I don't like the way it's closing the distance. Can you still see it when we turn away from the window?
[tense] Not yet. I can't watch it and watch the floor at the same time. Tell me before you change the step, will you?
[nervous] I will. And don't keep looking over my shoulder like that. Every time you do, I think something's already behind me.
